voxelprint.selection.nothing_to_clear: There was no selection to clear.
voxelprint.error.no_positions: Please set position 1 and position 2 first.
voxelprint.error.dimension_mismatch: Position 1 and position 2 are in different dimensions.
voxelprint.error.edge_exceeded: The selection exceeds the maximum edge length of %s blocks.
voxelprint.error.volume_exceeded: The selection exceeds the maximum volume of %s blocks.
voxelprint.config.title: VoxelPrint Settings
voxelprint.config.max_selection_volume.t: Largest number of blocks a selection may contain. Bigger selections take longer to read and use more memory.
voxelprint.config.max_selection_edge.too: Longest a single edge of a selection may be. Applies to width, height and depth alike.
voxelprint.config.debug_logging.tooltip: Writes extra diagnostic lines to the log. Useful when reporting a problem, noisy otherwise.
voxelprint.error.export_failed: Export failed. See the log for details.
voxelprint.error.invalid_name: The name contains invalid characters. Use letters, digits, hyphen and underscore only.
voxelprint.error.file_exists: A file with that name already exists.
voxelprint.error.export_running: You already have an export running.
voxelprint.error.chunks_not_loaded: Parts of the selection are not loaded. Move closer and try again.
voxelprint.config.export_directory.toolt: Where exports are written, relative to the game directory.
voxelprint.config.show_export_notificati: Show progress and success messages in chat. Errors are always shown.
voxelprint.config.include_air.tooltip: The structure always stores every block. This only decides whether air is counted and listed in the block summary.
voxelprint.config.create_block_summary.t: Writes block-summary.json into the export, listing every block state and how often it occurs.
voxelprint.config.overwrite_existing_exp: When off, exporting to an existing file name fails instead of replacing the file.
voxelprint.config.asynchronous_file_writ: Writes the file on a background thread. Turning this off blocks the game until the file is finished.
voxelprint.config.structure_format.toolt: Which structure file goes into the export. Both hold the same blocks; the schematic is what Minecraft tools read, the JSON needs no NBT parser.
voxelprint.error.no_target_block: You are not looking at a block within %s blocks.
voxelprint.config.show_selection_outline: Marks the edges of your selection with particles. Only you see it.
voxelprint.config.export_block_shapes.to: Records what each block actually looks like, so a stair is not a cube outside Minecraft. Costs a few kilobytes.
voxelprint.config.export_block_models.to: Records the real model of each block and the average colour of every texture it uses, so a torch is a torch and a piston has separate material regions.
voxelprint.config.model_colour_detail.to: How closely a face may follow its texture. One colour per face loses the head of a torch and the front of a furnace; higher catches them, at the cost of a larger file.
voxelprint.action.open_folder.hover: Open the folder the export was written to
voxelprint.action.upload.hover: Send this export to the VoxelPrint website
voxelprint.action.open_project.hover: Open the uploaded build in your browser
voxelprint.error.no_web_platform: No website is configured. Set it in the settings screen.
voxelprint.config.web_platform_url.toolt: Where the Upload button sends an export. Leave blank to switch uploading off.
